body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 371db9c7c72e50d7ddd320b5e7151303fbd8a18c -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Root cause is real and the fix is the minimal one: `shell.rs:98` turns the frame-start clear into `geo_hover_drawn = geo_hover.take()`, so the viewport reads last frame's row hover.
- Hover stays ephemeral. `geo_hover` and `geo_hover_drawn` are plain `State` view fields (`state.rs`), no command, no undo entry, no world write. The pin asserts `pending` is empty after hovering.
- No stale highlight. `row_hover_segments` goes through `feature_segments`, which the updated `hover_features_lights_the_face_boundary` pins for a stale face id, a gone entity name and a hidden model (all draw nothing). `GeoSel` holds an entity name, not a handle, so there is nothing to panic on. A deleted row, geometry or setup switch can show the old highlight for at most one frame.
- No repaint loop. `request_repaint` fires only while `geo_hover != geo_hover_drawn`. Walking the states: start of hover is one extra frame, steady hover is equal, and end of hover is one extra frame. Idle is quiet.
- Layering holds: the new ui code only uses `State`, `interact`, and egui. No `sys_*` or world calls.
- No PNG changed, no new dependency, no build.rs/scripts/.github/process files. New test module has a provenance line and a decision file is included. Style constants are named and the ink is checked distinct in both themes.

**Local results (PR merged with upstream/main d0b117db, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=1` (CWD crates/ui) | 710 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `geo_row_hover` (2 tests) + `hover_features_lights_the_face_boundary` | 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |

Mutation checks I ran (each reverted):
- carry dropped (`drawn = None`): the row-hover pin fails (but this mutant also clears `geo_hover`, so it is a blunt check).
- halo 7 to 3 px: style test fails.
- `row_hover_segments` reading `geo_hover` instead of `geo_hover_drawn`: all pass. This is the author's disclosed gap. It matters little: post-frame the two values are the same in a headless run, and the line is one token the screenshot exercises.
- repaint request disabled (`if false && ...`): all pass. Not disclosed. This one matters slightly more, since without the repaint the highlight would lag until the next input event. In practice pointer motion repaints anyway, so the visible effect is a stuck frame at the moment the hover ends with no further input. I would not block on it.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `interact.rs` (1763 lines), `shell.rs` (1006) and `state.rs` (4442) were already over the ~400-line guide; this PR adds 27/20/6 lines. Fine here, but worth a split issue when next touched.
2. A tiny pin for the repaint condition (extract `needs_repaint(hover, drawn)` and assert it) would close the second unpinned mutation cheaply.
3. `CHANGELOG.md` untouched (correct). Body has `Changelog:`, `Effort:` and `Fixes #1507`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
